description_en: Query Security Risk Handling Suggestions Details
description_zh: 查询安全分相关的安全风险的处理建议详情
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-secure-suggestion --source-ip 192.168.XX.XX --lang zh --cal-type home_security_score --source 0 --resource-directory-account-id 12324284232340000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSecureSuggestion

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language type for request and response messages, default is zh. Values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: Choose to query the new or old version of the security score rules. When the value is home_security_score, it queries the new version of the security score rules; otherwise, it defaults to querying the old version of the security score rules
parameters.help_zh: 选择查询新版安全分或旧版安全分规则，当取值为home_security_score时，查询新版安全分规则，否则默认查询旧版安全分规则
parameters.name: cal_type

parameters.help_en:
Source of the security score. If left empty, it defaults to Cloud Security Center. Enumerated values:

0: Cloud Security Center.

1: Yaochi Console
parameters.help_zh:
安全分来源，传空默认为云安全中心，枚举值：

0：云安全中心。

1：瑶池控制台
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
Resource directory member account ID (Alibaba Cloud account).
You can obtain this parameter by calling the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) API
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id
